claims.description: One row per factual assertion. NOT FOUND items are rows too, with value 'NOT FOUND' and no quote.

field.description: Short snake_case name of what the row asserts, e.g. total_funding, hq_city, open_role.

value.description: The fact itself, as concisely as the source states it, or 'NOT FOUND'.

source_url.description: The URL the quote was read on. Empty only for NOT FOUND.

quote.description: VERBATIM span from that page that states the value. Never paraphrased.
